governing_question: How do we build a government powerful enough to protect rights, administer common institutions and maintain fair markets, while preventing government itself—or accumulated private wealth—from becoming powerful enough to dominate the people?
central_proposition: Government possesses delegated power; the people possess sovereignty. Prosperity cannot justify unlimited government, and liberty cannot survive government unconstrained by law—nor can concentrated economic resources purchase unequal sovereignty.
organizing_sentence: Government & Democratic Power is the constitutional and democratic core of the unabridged system: purpose and limits of collective authority, popular sovereignty, rights, representation and direct democracy, subsidiarity, four roles with a Role Conflict Test, capable administration, public-dollar accountability, anti-capture architecture, justice relationships, Digital Due Process, Comprehensible Government, and a closed Accountability Loop.

purpose_of_government.title: Purpose of government

spheres.label: Community / local sphere
spheres.rule: Decisions appropriately made close to those affected.

spheres.label: Government sphere
spheres.rule: Legitimate collective authority exercised under constitutional constraint.

purpose_of_government.test: What legitimate public purpose requires collective authority, at what level, under what constitutional power, with what safeguards and accountability?

popular_sovereignty.title: Popular sovereignty
popular_sovereignty.principle: Government possesses delegated power. The people possess sovereignty.

distinction.delegation_of_authority: Citizens authorize agents to exercise defined powers for a term.
distinction.transfer_of_sovereignty: Citizens do not surrender political ownership for two or four years.

popular_sovereignty.join: Direct-democracy architecture is the pressure-release when representation fails.

constitutional_order.title: Constitutional order and rights
constitutional_order.central_principle: Prosperity cannot justify unlimited government, and liberty cannot survive government unconstrained by law.
constitutional_order.purpose: Explain how constitutional restraint fits the political-economic system — not a constitutional-law encyclopedia.

representative_democracy.title: Representative democracy
representative_democracy.harvest_rule: Substantial prior work exists — harvest; do not reopen.

direct_democracy.title: Direct democracy
direct_democracy.principle: Initiative and referendum are constitutional pressure-release mechanisms — not merely election procedures.
direct_democracy.when: When representative institutions become captured or systematically unresponsive, citizens retain a lawful mechanism for changing policy directly.
direct_democracy.safeguard: Direct democracy itself must operate inside constitutional protections and transparent rules.

subsidiarity.title: Subsidiarity
subsidiarity.principle: Exercise power at the lowest level capable of performing the function effectively while protecting rights and legitimate statewide interests.
decision_test: Does fragmentation make the function impossible?

four_roles.title: Government's four roles

roles.label: Rulemaker
roles.meaning: Creates general rules under which people and markets interact.

roles.label: Referee
roles.meaning: Enforces rules, rights, contracts and competition.

roles.label: Provider
roles.meaning: Delivers justified public goods and services.

roles.label: Investor / Owner
roles.meaning: Deploys or owns productive capital where specifically justified.

four_roles.prior_conflict_rule: Roles should not be casually blended. Public ownership of a competitor while regulating rivals is a structural conflict for Stage 3 examination.

role_conflict_test.title: Role Conflict Test
role_conflict_test.when: When government occupies multiple roles in the same market.
questions: Can it write rules favoring itself?
Can failure be hidden through public subsidy?
Can citizens distinguish public purpose from political favoritism?
role_conflict_test.join_3_4: Especially important for public-income architecture from Pass 3.4.

administrative_government.title: Administrative government
administrative_government.insight: A complex state cannot operate entirely through elected officials.

distinction.political_direction: Elected/constitutional direction of ends and constraints.

administrative_government.goal: Capable government with bounded authority — not simply smaller or larger government.

distinction.spending_authority: A dollar appropriated is not an accomplishment.
distinction.successful_outcome: A contract executed is not an accomplishment.
distinction.question: What public purpose was actually achieved?

capture_architecture.title: Anti-corruption and Capture Loop

circuit_breaker_families.label: Competition
circuit_breaker_families.interrupts: Monopoly of office, contracts, and markets

circuit_breaker_families.label: Distributed political power
circuit_breaker_families.interrupts: Single-chokepoint capture of elections or institutions

circuit_breaker_families.label: Citizen review / recourse
circuit_breaker_families.interrupts: No appeal from administrative or automated harm

circuit_breaker_families.label: Constitutional rights
circuit_breaker_families.interrupts: Majority or agency erasure of liberty floors

capture_architecture.architecture_rule: Explain where capture occurs and what type of control belongs at each point — not design 100 ethics laws.

justice_public_safety.title: Justice and public safety
justice_public_safety.principle: Public safety protects the conditions under which liberty, community and economic participation can exist.
justice_public_safety.economic_join: Fines, incarceration, criminal records, inability to work, family disruption and re-entry barriers affect household prosperity and community capital.
justice_public_safety.not: Do not become a criminal-justice-policy book. Establish system relationships; route detailed reforms appropriately.

digital_due_process.title: Data rights, privacy and AI government

distinction.ai_assisting_employee: AI may help a public employee decide.
distinction.ai_exercising_authority: AI must not silently exercise state authority.

digital_due_process.principle: AI may assist government. It must not silently become government.
digital_due_process.prior_statement: AI may assist government. It should not silently become government.

comprehensible_government.title: Comprehensible Government
comprehensible_government.insight: Publishing 10,000 PDFs isn't meaningful transparency if citizens cannot understand them.

counterarguments.claim: Direct democracy produces populism or bad technical policy.
counterarguments.strong_form: Ballot measures are demagoguery that wrecks expert governance.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Direct democracy is a pressure-release inside constitutional rights and transparent rules—not unconstrained majoritarianism. Complex technical domains still require administration under statute; initiative revises the statute.

counterarguments.strong_form: Local variation means poor counties get worse government permanently.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Subsidiarity ladder includes rights protection and statewide interests; fragmentation that makes a function impossible escalates. Local experimentation ≠ abandonment of floors.

counterarguments.strong_form: Subsidiarity and direct democracy empower oppression.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Constitutional rights and equal protection bind every level. Popular sovereignty does not authorize rights violations.

counterarguments.strong_form: Any limit on money in politics is censorship.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: CX-P3-01 remains OPEN. Architecture targets purchasing preferential rules/contracts/assets—not equality of opinion. Circuit breakers are structural, not viewpoint bans.

counterarguments.strong_form: Merit systems create a permanent deep state.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Distinguish political direction from professional administration; require statutory authority, appeal, audit, sunset/review, and public accessibility. Capable ≠ sovereign.

counterarguments.strong_form: Open government forces disclosure of private lives.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Comprehensible Government answers public-purpose questions; Digital Due Process and privacy rights constrain what may be published about persons.

counterarguments.claim: AI can make government fairer than humans.
counterarguments.strong_form: Replace discretion with algorithms and bias disappears.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: AI may assist; it must not silently become government. Digital Due Process requires notice, explanation, human accountability, challenge, correction, auditability.
Measurement targets public promises, spend, delivery, and outcomes—not total population monitoring. Privacy and Digital Due Process bound data use.

counterarguments.claim: Government cannot fairly referee a market it owns.
counterarguments.strong_form: Any public enterprise is inherently corrupt.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Role Conflict Test forces separation questions: self-favoring rules, equal treatment, independent audit, risk pricing, subsidy concealment, public-purpose clarity. Join 3.4 waterfall.
Distributed breakers: transparency, competition, citizen review, constitutional rights, elections/direct democracy/courts. No single watchdog owns the loop.

counterarguments.claim: Public dashboards manipulate citizens through selective metrics.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Require claim classes, source hierarchy, and Unknown beats fabricated precision. Dashboards expose methods and gaps—not only favorable numbers.

counterarguments.claim: What prevents Constitutional Capitalism itself from becoming the ideology through which future officials justify accumulating more power?
counterarguments.strong_form: CC is a blank check for expansionary government.
counterarguments.architecture_answer: Answer is structural, not rhetorical: constitutional rights floors; separation of powers; subsidiarity; Role Conflict Test; public-income waterfall/COUNTABLE discipline; Capture Loop circuit breakers; Comprehensible Government; closed Accountability Loop returning sovereignty to the people; and Stage 4 adversarial testing that can MODIFY/REPLACE/REMOVE architecture. No prosperity claim authorizes unlimited power.
counterarguments.unresolved: STAGE_4 adversarial attack on CC power claims
